system.description:
You fold into a horrid melding of human and bat — face gnarled into a grimace, arms stretched into taloned leathery wings.

Spend three Blood Traits. You gain all the benefits of Horrid Form plus the ability to fly at up to 25 mph (Celerity does not increase this) and to carry aloft up to your own body weight, though burdened flight is clumsy. The bony claws at your wingtips act as Feral Claws. You are down two Traits on all hearing-based perception challenges but gain one bonus Trait on any vision-based wits or perception challenges. The form lasts for the scene once invoked.
